subject: Changes to how we run tests coming soon.

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Changes to how we run tests coming soon.
parts:
Hi all,

Mitzi and I have been working on a branch that changes the way the tests are run. This simplifies the makefiles drastically (Marcus and Ben, it should be a lot easier to port now), but requires python for the developers.

I've started a wiki for how to run the tests:
https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/Stan-developers:-running-tests

The big changes:
- Make arguments need to go into make/local. You'll have to run `> git update-index --assume-unchanged make/local` once (and only once) in order for git to ignore changes to that file.
- from the command line, we're going to call a python script, runTests.py
- the arguments to runTests.py will be either a test file or a directory (no trailing slash). No need to change the test name to the test executable.
- dependency generation works through make, so there shouldn't be too many reasons to run make clean first.

If anyone has any feedback, please send it out. The branch is feature/very-experimental-makefix
https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/tree/feature/very-experimental-makefix




Daniel
